prompts.name: characters
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: raster avatar sprite sheet for Taste Vault identity studio. Generate one square 1024x1024 image, divided into an EXACT invisible 2x2 grid of four equal 512x512 quadrants. Each quadrant has ONE different centered avatar, all at consistent scale, fully contained in the middle of its own quadrant with generous margins. Centers precisely at (256,256), (768,256), (256,768), (768,768). Seamless common flat light warm gray background #f0eee9 across all quadrants. Clean high-end 3D editorial studio artwork, soft directional lighting and tiny shadows. No lines, labels, borders, text, watermarks, cards, or additional objects. This is a sprite sheet, not a UI mockup. Four distinct original collectible clay 3D mascots. Top-left: coral orange squishy rounded cube with two simple black eyes. Top-right: cobalt blue curvy bean with two simple black eyes. Bottom-left: lime green soft four-point star with two black eyes. Bottom-right: butter yellow pill with asymmetrical black eyes. Tactile matte material, bold soft silhouette, friendly restrained personality, no extra limbs or props. All four approximately equally sized and occupy at most 64% of the width and height of their quadrant.
